title: Install a .pkg file from Terminal
summary: Use the installer command to install a downloaded .pkg file. This is useful when the graphical installer fails or when you need to install to a specific volume.

steps.explain: Run the installer command with sudo to install the package to the root volume. Replace <PKG_FILE> with the path to your .pkg file.

placeholders.name: PKG_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .pkg file you want to install

rollback.explain: Uninstalling a .pkg file via command line is complex and often requires the original package's uninstall script or manual removal of files. There is no simple undo command for this.

warnings: Installing packages can modify system files. Ensure you trust the source of the .pkg file.
You will be prompted for your administrator password.
